plugins.description: Crop & plant bioinformatics skills for Claude Code: SNP-Seek (3K rice genomes), RicePilaf post-GWAS browser, crop GWAS, crop genome annotation, Crop/Plant/Trait ontologies, BUSCO, phylogenetics, RNA-seq DE, and variant calling. Local-first, reproducible, breeding-focused.
